name: Ride to Orgrimmar
summary: A wind rider carries Horde travelers from the Crossroads to Orgrimmar. With Zargh’s fresh cuts of meat in hand, you fly to the capital’s Skytower and deliver them to Innkeeper Gryshka.

sections.title: Wings Over the Savanna
sections.body: Devrak sends trained wind riders between the Crossroads and Orgrimmar. The flight crosses the dry Barrens and reaches Durotar’s red cliffs, sparing travelers the hard journey on foot. From high above the dusty canyon trails, the wyverns carry messengers and travelers, along with dispatches and trade goods, straight to the capital.

sections.title: Special Delivery for Gryshka
sections.body: Zargh has prepared fresh cuts of meat for Innkeeper Gryshka in Orgrimmar’s Valley of Strength. From the central Skytower, her inn is a short walk away. Gryshka accepts the parcel and remarks with fondness that Zargh knows how to win a lady’s heart.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this flight?
faq.answer: The flight introduces you to the Horde’s wind rider routes. You pay Devrak for passage from the Crossroads to Orgrimmar and carry Zargh’s fresh cuts of meat to Innkeeper Gryshka.

faq.q: Where does the wind rider land in Orgrimmar?
aliases: where do i land in org
faq.answer: The wind rider lands at Orgrimmar’s Skytower, above the Valley of Strength. Ramps lead down to the main square, nearby vendors, and Gryshka’s inn.
Innkeeper Gryshka runs a tavern in Orgrimmar’s Valley of Strength. She welcomes travelers and shares a fond friendship with Zargh, who supplies fresh cuts for her kitchen.
Devrak is the wind rider master at the Crossroads in the Barrens. He tends the wyverns and coordinates air travel between the outpost, Durotar, and other Horde settlements.

faq.q: Why is Zargh sending raw meat to Gryshka?
faq.answer: Zargh sends Gryshka fresh game from the Barrens as an offering. She appreciates the choice cuts and says they win her heart.

faq.q: What should I do after delivering the meat?
aliases: what next after ride to orgrimmar
faq.answer: After you deliver the meat, Gryshka sends you back to the Skytower to speak with Doras, Orgrimmar’s wind rider master, about the return flight.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can travel by wind rider between the Crossroads in the central Barrens and Orgrimmar, where Warchief Thrall rules.
Gryshka makes her taste clear when she receives Zargh’s gift: she prefers the finest beasts of Kalimdor served rare, to preserve their flavor.
